artifacts.description: feat(io): JSON Schema for a part's model.json, format v0.1

acceptance_criteria: New `docs/specs/schema/model-part-0.1.json`: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 (`"$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema"`), with `title` and `description`, canonical style (2-space indent, keys sorted), and: `type: object`, no top-level `required`, and no `additionalProperties: false` at any level (readers keep unknown fields); `properties` for `parameters`, `origin`, `sketches`, `features`, `end_of_part` and `bodies` (`end_of_part`: `type: string`; the arrays: `type: array`); each of the five ID arrays has `items` of `type: object` with `required: ["id"]` and `id`: `type: string`, `minLength: 1`; sketch `entities` and `constraints` are nested under `sketches.items.properties`; each ID array's `description` says IDs are unique within the array and that every array except `features` is written sorted by `id` (rules a schema cannot express; `swx-io` enforces them).
`docs/specs/schema/README.md` lists the new file in one line.

New integration test `crates/swx-io/tests/model_schema.rs` (schema read by path from `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`): the schema parses and is byte-identical to its canonical form; every top-level key of `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/bracket.sltwx/model.json` is in the schema's top-level `properties`; the test walks the schema's `properties` / `items` / `required` / `type` / `minLength` keywords (a small checker in the test, those keywords only): the golden model passes, and a copy with (1) an entity without `id`, (2) `"id": 5` on a body, (3) `"id": ""` on a feature fails the checker **and** is rejected by `read_unpacked`; a copy with two bodies sharing an `id` passes the checker but is rejected by `read_unpacked` (documents the rule the schema can't express).
All existing tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
